description: Average Annual Daily Traffic (AADT) Counts at Point Locations on the DTI Highway Network is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. This dataset shows the average annual daily traffic (AADT) counts at specific point locations on the DTI highway network. Data was collected in 2023. Coverage: Government of New Brunswick. The portal files it under the publisher Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Its tags are highway, traffic, circulation, counts, comptages. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-06-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - New Brunswick. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
